videos.desc: In a wooden-floored hallway a hand holds a black dog bowl full of brown dry food and pushes a small white pill down into the middle of it, then covers the spot with a dollop of white yoghurt. A black and white husky comes to the bowl and eats. When it lifts its head the bowl is put down on the floor: all the food and the yoghurt are gone and only the single white pill is left lying on the bare bottom of the bowl. The husky sits in the doorway and stares into the camera.

A ginger and white cat sits on a low stone ledge outside a zoo enclosure, at the black iron bars. On the other side a huge male lion with a dark mane walks straight up to the bars and lowers its head until its face is right in front of the cat, the two noses almost touching through the bars. A lioness comes up behind and bares her teeth. The cat stays sitting where it is; the lions turn and walk away across the muddy enclosure, and the cat sits calmly at the bars with visitors watching in the distance.

A golden hamster comes along a sunlit garden path with a white daisy held in its mouth. It stumbles and goes flat on its face on the paving, the daisy still with it, lies there a moment with its eyes shut, then pushes itself up, sits back on its haunches and holds the daisy against its chest, facing the camera in the low evening light.

A golden hamster sits on a white kitchen counter beside the sink, eating a green scouring pad out of a small round white dish. A white box like a phone box is set down next to the dish and a second hamster peeks in from the right. The hamster leaves the dish, sniffs along the edge of the box and nibbles at its lid until the box opens to show a yellow and green sponge inside, then rears up on its back legs.

At night, a torch shines into the open window of a dark red pickup truck. A golden retriever in a camouflage jacket and cap sits upright in the driver's seat with a paw on the steering wheel, staring back at the camera. In the seat beside it a dachshund in an orange hat sits stiffly. Nobody moves for a long moment. Then the shot cuts to the truck's red tail lights speeding away down an unlit country road.
videos.said: Evening. Where y'all coming from? Oh, you know, we were just out there hunting squirrels. Why does your friend look like that? Dispatch, I got a vehicle fleeing. Code 3.

videos.desc: At a marine park with palm trees and empty rows of stadium seating, a shirtless man crouches at the edge of a big turquoise pool holding a large silver ball and talks to a bottlenose dolphin resting at the wall. The dolphin lifts its head and listens, then backs off into open water, launches itself high into the air upside down and strikes the ball away with its tail. The man leaps up with both hands on his head, mouth wide open, watching the ball fly off into the blue sky.
videos.said: Hey buddy, do you like Messi? Do you like Ronaldo? Can you show us Ronaldo's overhead kick?

videos.desc: Inside a wooden aviary with wire mesh walls in a green wood, a young woman in a green T-shirt and a baseball cap holds a large peacock in her arms and laughs. The bird's deep blue neck and chest fill most of the frame, its crest standing up on its head and its scaly clawed feet dangling against her arm. It leans its head in towards her face, and at the end stretches its long blue neck straight towards the camera until the shining blue feathers fill the shot.
videos.said: Sometimes you just gotta add them to your video. Ready? See? They just, you know.

videos.desc: A first-person view from the back of a flying red dragon. Two hands grip a saddle horn in the bottom of the frame and the dragon's broad red back, covered in rows of dark spikes running down the spine, stretches away in front. The dragon glides over green valleys, blue lakes and waterfalls, then tips forward and dives towards a canyon where two waterfalls fall into a river. It raises its head and blows a burst of fire up into the sky with its wings spread wide, and finally levels off and glides towards a golden sunset over a wide lake.

An animated pond scene. A baby panda and a small green turtle swim underwater below a big lily pad, blowing streams of bubbles, while a grumpy fish watches from behind. They shoot up out of the water and fly through the air above a sunlit bamboo forest with their arms and legs flung out and shocked faces. Then the panda sits on a huge floating lily pad with the turtle clamped in a tight hug against its chest, arms wrapped right around the shell; the grumpy fish pokes its head out of the water below. The last shot shows the panda squeezing the turtle close among pink water lilies.

A rectangular garden pool with a blue rim and clear turquoise water stands on a lawn in bright sunshine, with a row of small conifers and a dark fence behind it. Two Jack Russell terriers swim in the pool pushing a big red ball with their noses. One paddles across the pool nudging the ball ahead of it towards the camera, water sparkling in the sun, while the second dog swims behind. At the end the red ball rests against the sunlit edge of the pool in close-up with the second terrier still paddling towards it.

A shaggy grey dog tears across a wide, wet dark-sand beach below green cliffs on an overcast day. It wheels round, sprints up the grassy dune straight at the camera until its fur fills the screen, then throws itself down in the long grass and rolls on its back with all four legs in the air, a collar round its neck.

A guide in a khaki shirt stands in dense green rainforest holding a leafy twig with a bright green chameleon on it, grinning into the camera. He slides a piece of rough brown bark under the animal; it steps across onto the wood and its skin turns from green to a striped orange-brown that matches the bark exactly. He stares at it wide-eyed and delighted.

A woman lies on the grass in a dog park filming herself. A small fluffy white dog plants itself right in front of the camera, opens its mouth wide and starts barking at it. A big spotted dog and a large black-and-white dog behind join in with their heads up and mouths open, and the two women sitting behind pull shocked faces and clap their hands over their ears while the little dog keeps going.

An older man in a flat cap and a dark knitted cardigan stands at the stern rail of a ferry crossing the Bosphorus at dusk, with the wake churning white behind him and a domed mosque and the city skyline on the shore. He holds a torn piece of bread in one hand and holds crumbs out in the other. One big white and grey sea bird glides in from the left at head height with its wings fully spread; then a second and a third arrive, and by the end of the clip a dozen of them are hanging in the air all around him, wings out and red beaks open, some almost within touching distance while he laughs.

A living room with a balcony full of houseplants. A grey tabby house cat lies flat on a rug with its belly to the floor, eyes locked on a small grey toy mouse on the wooden floor in front of it. Its owner sits at a low table behind, watching open-mouthed and covering his mouth with excitement. The cat wiggles, springs forward at the toy, then settles on the floor with its paws crossed, looking straight at the camera while the man throws up his hands.

A ranger in a khaki uniform and cap stands on a wooden jetty over green river water and points behind her, eyes wide and mouth open in surprise. A large grey hippo floats just off the deck with its head and back above the water, then sinks lower and lower until only its nostrils and finally just ripples are left on the surface, while she keeps staring at the camera.

A young man in a bright palm-print shirt tours a zoo holding a spotting sheet of animal pictures. He crouches on the grass and lets a goat eat a handful of hay out of his hands, then stands at a glass pool where penguins stand on the rocks and swim past him, and finally holds a leafy branch up to a giraffe that leans over the wooden fence and takes the leaves with its tongue.

A sunny country fair with bunting, a navy gazebo and a crowd of visitors. A young man in a white linen shirt and a young woman with long wavy red hair in a green denim jacket stand by a low wooden pen and both point at the same fluffy golden puppy, then turn to each other and laugh because they picked the same one. The puppy stands up with its paws on the fence and sniffs at the woman's hand while more golden puppies play in the straw around it.

A meadow of tall grass in golden evening light. A young woman beekeeper with dark hair tied back, in a white bee jacket with the veil pushed back, leather gloves and olive trousers, holds up a wooden honeycomb panel crawling with bees and cries out in delight, then laughs. Hundreds of living bees swarm and buzz in the air around the panel. Behind her, rows of pale blue wooden hives stand in the grass where two older men in bee jackets work, and a metal smoker puffs white smoke.

A stable deep with straw, with the door open to a pink dawn sky. A newborn chestnut foal stands on its long, thin, shaky legs, straw stuck to its damp coat, wobbling as it tries to keep its balance, while the brown mare leans down beside it. A young woman with a red braid, in a blue puffer jacket and work gloves, kneels in the straw next to them, laughing with joy and clapping her hands. Another person holds a bundle of hay and a black bucket hangs on the wall.

Seen through a doorway, a sunny whitewashed courtyard with a red tiled roof and a cobbled floor. A young woman in a burgundy riding shirt, beige breeches and tall black boots holds the bridle of a dappled grey horse and smiles. A young man in a light blue shirt and cream trousers stands in front of the horse, reaches one hand towards its head while looking at her, then gently strokes its face, smiling. A leather saddle rests on a stand behind them, with red geraniums in pots, a wall lantern and loose straw.

On a misty mountain lake at dawn, with pine forests and a pink sky, a golden retriever sits alone at the end of a wooden jetty with one front paw raised, watching a person in a red jacket row a small wooden boat away across the calm water. The dog lowers its paw, turns its head, then lies down on the planks with its chin on its paws. Beside it lie a red lead, a steel water bowl and a pair of sandals. Far off on the right another person stands on a small dock.

On a salt marsh at dawn, with muddy creeks, green grass and a line of geese flying across a pale sky, a young woman in a flat cap, a waxed olive jacket, green trousers and rubber boots stands holding several wild ducks she has caught, hanging from a strap. She lifts the strap with the ducks over her shoulder and then reaches down to stroke a wet golden retriever that stands beside her looking up. A canvas bag with a flask lies on the grass at her feet.

A large herd of cattle crosses a shallow river at sunrise under a cloudy golden sky. A big, dark brown, stocky bullock walks out of the water onto a pebbly bank in the foreground, splashing, with a brown calf beside it. Behind them dozens of brown, black and white-faced cattle wade through the river, white egrets stand and fly among them, and riders on horses wait on the far bank near a farmhouse and willow trees.

At night in a tropical rainforest a white sheet is stretched between a rope and a wooden pole and lit by a hanging lantern. It is covered with hundreds of insects: moths with spread wings, beetles, green shield bugs, grasshoppers and flies, with a huge dark horned beetle crawling slowly across the middle. Moths flutter on and off the sheet, a swarm flies around the lamp, a green praying mantis clings to the pole, and a wooden crate with a notebook stands on the leaf-covered ground.

On the dusty African savanna at sunset, with acacia trees and white birds flying up, a young woman with long braids in dusty overalls pulls a big canvas sheet off a life-size model of a young elephant standing on a wooden trolley with wheels. A real adult elephant stands beside it and reaches its trunk towards the model. The woman looks up and laughs, the sheet lies on the trolley, and two rangers in khaki stand behind with their hands on their heads.

At night in an empty ancient stone arena under a full moon, a large dark brown cricket with long thin antennae sits on the rim of a shiny brass tuba lying on the wooden stage. It walks slowly along the rim and spreads its wings. Behind it the stage is set for an orchestra with empty chairs, music stands, a double bass lying on its side and copper kettle drums. A tall floor lamp glows on the right with small moths flying around it, and empty stone seats rise behind.

The African savanna in hazy golden light. A spotted leopard lies stretched along the thick branch of a lone acacia tree, its long tail hanging down and curling at the tip. Draped over the same branch next to its head hangs the limp body of a small brown antelope it has caught, its thin legs dangling in the air. The leopard opens its mouth in a wide yawn, then lays its head down beside the antelope and rests. Below the tree, tall dry golden grass stretches away to low hills on the horizon.

In a snowy old market street, a large male red deer with huge branching antlers stands on top of a wooden fruit cart full of red apples, bellowing, while apples tumble over the icy cobblestones. A smaller female deer without antlers stands on the left. The male jumps down from the cart and walks straight towards the viewer among the scattered apples, bellowing again. Market stalls with torn striped awnings line the stone houses, and men in winter coats run behind with a barking dog.

On a misty green clifftop by the sea, a young woman in an orange rain jacket and a knitted orange headband kneels in the long grass and uses small pliers to fix a little tag onto the leg of a puffin she holds, while another puffin stands on top of her head. Then she stands up and throws the tagged puffin into the air, and it flies away over the cliff as the puffin on her head flaps its wings. An open tin of orange tags lies in the grass and a colleague in an orange jacket with a clipboard laughs.

On a windy green hilltop under dark storm clouds, a young woman with red hair in a long dark green dress stands barefoot and points firmly across the field while her dress blows in the wind. A black and white sheepdog drives a small group of white sheep through an open wooden gate towards the front. The sheep run past and out of sight, and the dog crouches low on the muddy grass by the gate. A quad bike, a white canvas tent and fallen metal hurdles stand on the grass behind her.

On a honeycomb in sunlight, a larger bee with a long, shiny orange-and-brown striped body stands over the wax cells, clearly bigger than all the others. A small white egg sits at the tip of her body over an empty cell. She moves slowly across the comb while a crowd of smaller worker bees with hairy brown bodies and clear wings walks around her, many facing her and touching her with their antennae. Further down, the cells glisten with golden honey.

The view from inside an orange tent at dawn. The viewer's hands in mustard sleeves pull the tent door open. Just outside, only a step away, a red fox stands on the grass, sniffs at the tent and the hand holding the door, then lifts its head and looks around. Behind it lie hiking boots, a black kettle and a metal mug on a flat rock, and a canoe on the grass. Tall pine trees stand beside a misty lake, with mountains under a pale pink sky.

A cosy living room with wood-panelled walls, a glowing orange lamp and a thick rust-coloured rug. A black Labrador walks over a big pile of colourful soft toys in front of an open cardboard box, carrying only one of them in its mouth, a yellow rubber duck, and lies down with it. A young woman in a green top kneels on the rug laughing, holding up a toy fox that the dog ignores. Plants, records and a brown sofa fill the room.

A farm in green hills at sunset. A chestnut horse with a light mane stands in long grass while a man in a blue shirt and a leather wristband holds its face gently with both hands and strokes it. The view moves closer and the horse lowers its head and half closes its eyes as he strokes its forehead. Behind them are an old stone barn with a slate roof, a gravel track, a wooden gate and white wildflowers, all glowing in warm golden evening light.

A sunny cottage garden with a thatched cottage, a white picket fence and flowers behind. In the foreground a person in a blue top holds out a big cream towel with both hands, ready to dry a dog; beside them stand a metal tub of soapy water and a green garden hose. On the lawn a freshly washed white poodle splashes into a muddy puddle, rolls in it until it is brown, shakes itself and stands up in the mud looking pleased with itself. A brick path leads to the cottage.
